definitions.gloss: dialogue; conversation; talk between two people
definitions.explanation: A formal or semi-formal conversation between two people, often published or broadcast. Commonly refers to an interview or discussion format in media.

examples.japanese: {作家|さっか}との{対談|たいだん}。
{二人|ふたり}の{専門家|せんもんか}が{対談|たいだん}した。
{雑誌|ざっし}に{掲載|けいさい}された{対談|たいだん}{記事|きじ}がとても{面白|おもしろ}かった。
examples.english: The dialogue article published in the magazine was very interesting.

notes:
Composed of {対|たい} (facing, opposing) + {談|だん} (talk). Specifically refers to a two-person conversation, often in a published or broadcast format. Used as both a noun and a する verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対談|たいだん}する: to have a dialogue
- {対談|たいだん}{記事|きじ}: dialogue article; published conversation
- {対談|たいだん}{番組|ばんぐみ}: talk show (dialogue format)
- {対談|たいだん}{集|しゅう}: collection of dialogues
- {対談|たいだん}{相手|あいて}: dialogue partner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {会話|かいわ}: everyday conversation (informal, any number of people)
- {鼎談|ていだん}: three-person discussion (rare, literary)
- {座談|ざだん}: roundtable talk (more than two people, informal setting)
- インタビュー: interview (one person asks, one answers — less equal than {対談|たいだん})
